About the Swami's Monthly Sunday Social Ride group ride

North County's big club opens one ride a month to anyone comfortable with 30 miles: a two-by-two, conversational, no-drop loop from a coffee shop in Bressi Ranch. Its weekly Saturday A/B ride out of Encinitas is the fast one, and it is not no-drop.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
